# RP Guideline 2 - Follow proper naming conventions
Your IC name must be reasonable and fit into the game's setting. "Glup Shitto" wont be allowed here. This is a medium roleplay server first and foremost.
\n
- Dont use joke names, real world brand references, existing fictional characters or names parodying them (e.g. Paul Badman, Tom Ford)
- Don't use other characters names from existing players, impersonation in this way is considered a knowing violation of consent.
- All species have a naming convention, which you should generally follow (but are not required to)
